brief.about: The Arts of Becoming is a living body of work by Kathleen Marie Rose: practices, experiences and creative works for remembering your nature, liberating what is alive, and bringing more of your truth into form. It includes The Thread (1:1 mentorship), embodiment and practice, courses and circles, earth and living systems, creative work, and a journal. True To Essence is her separate photography world.
brief.audience: People in a season of change who want to remember who they are and live it more truthfully. They should explore the arts, begin a conversation about The Thread, read the journal, or inquire.
brief.notes: Standalone site for artsofbecoming.com. True To Essence (truetoessence.com) is a separate photography site: link out to it, no photography pages or prices here. Nav: Home, The Arts, The Thread, Journal, About, Inquire, plus a True To Essence link. Voice and palette carried from the old Become in Beauty site (deep brown on soft cream).
